name: m2749-footprints
prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 photoreal, Arabian desert region in the 7th century, bright warm morning light, vibrant natural colours, high detail. The sun disc is NOT visible. No faces, no text, no modern objects. A smooth sunlit golden sand dune with a sharp curved crest under a clear blue sky. Across the near slope runs ONE line of human footprints, oval sandal prints one after another, leading up toward the crest. A steady wind blows a thin, LOW veil of fine sand along the surface from left to right - grains streaming just above the sand and spilling over the crest - already softening and partly filling the edges of the prints. Crisp small wind ripples on the sand. No person anywhere, no animal, no plants.
